checks.name: collections_name_check
checks.def: CHECK (((char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) >= 1) AND (char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM name)) <= 100)))

checks.name: listings_lat_range_check
checks.def: CHECK (((lat IS NULL) OR ((lat >= ('-90'::integer)::double precision) AND (lat <= (90)::double precision))))

checks.name: listings_lng_range_check
checks.def: CHECK (((lng IS NULL) OR ((lng >= ('-180'::integer)::double precision) AND (lng <= (180)::double precision))))
